name: @topcoat-spike/melange-compare
description: The Melange core-logic comparison: the krausest non-keyed store written twice, once in OCaml compiled by the Melange playground and once in Rust compiled by this backend, measured for size, node micro-performance and readability.
$note-why-a-separate-package: contract/parity/package.json is the precedent: a harness that needs one npm
dependency gets its own package with its own node_modules and its own
lockfile, rather than putting that dependency where every other harness in
the spike would inherit it. Nothing else in the spike has a node dependency
at all -- the contract harness vendors what it compares against -- and this
one needs a browser driver for exactly one reason: the Melange playground is
the only Melange compiler available here (no opam), and it is a client side
WebAssembly bundle, so the only way to run it is to load the page.
puppeteer-CORE, not puppeteer: -core downloads no browser. The Chrome this
drives is the one already installed at /Applications/Google Chrome.app,
named by executablePath, which is also the browser the krausest harness in
the sibling tracks uses. One browser, one version, recorded in the report.
